title: Changes in Generations of PAMAM Dendrimers and Compositions of Nucleic Acid Nanoparticles Govern Delivery and Immune Recognition.
authors: Avila, Yelixza I; Rebolledo, Laura P; Leal Santos, Nathalia; Rawlins, Brandon; Radwan, Yasmine; Andrade-Munoz, Melanie; Skelly, Elizabeth; Chandler, Morgan R; Andrade, Luciana N S; Kim, Tae Jin; Dobrovolskaia, Marina A; Afonin, Kirill A
one_liner_zh: 该文用分子动力学模拟研究PAMAM树状大分子与核酸纳米颗粒（DNA/RNA立方体）的相互作用，并评估其递送和免疫识别，虽涉及蛋白-DNA互作建模但非TF-DNA体系，方法可迁移至本课题。
abstract: Nucleic acid nanoparticles (NANPs) are promising immune modulators due to their well-established structural properties and distinct structure-activity relationship with the immune system. We previously identified that NANPs' size, shape, composition, and type of delivery vehicle define their uptake by immune cells and subsequently induced cytokine profile. In this work, we examined the delivery efficiencies and immunological impacts of two representative NANPs horizontal line DNA cubes and RNA cubes horizontal line complexed with a benchmark delivery vehicle, Lipofectamine 2000 vs. different generations of amine-terminated poly(amidoamine) dendrimers. Using molecular dynamics simulations, we modeled dendrimer interactions with nucleic acid cargos. Next, we used traditional 2D and more recently established 3D cell cultures to assess dendrimers' influence on NANPs uptake. Immune activation was evaluated in several cell lines engineered with reporter genes driven by key immune signaling pathways. Specifically, HEK-lucia reporter cells were used to evaluate RIG-I activation, while THP1-Dual cells provided quantitative readouts for both IRF and NF-kappaB transcription factor activity. Our findings demonstrate that both dendrimer generation and NANP composition influence cellular uptake and immune responses. This study underscores the importance of formulation in shaping NANPs' biological properties and further advances the understanding of their immunological properties critical for the development of NANPs-based adjuvants.
abstract_zh: 核酸纳米颗粒（NANPs）因其明确的结构特性和与免疫系统之间独特的构效关系，而成为有前景的免疫调节剂。我们此前已确定，NANPs的尺寸、形状、组成及递送载体类型决定了它们被免疫细胞摄取的方式及随后诱导的细胞因子谱。在本研究中，我们考察了两种代表性NANPs——水平线DNA立方体和RNA立方体——分别与基准递送载体Lipofectamine 2000及不同代胺封端聚（酰胺胺）树枝状聚合物复合后的递送效率和免疫学影响。利用分子动力学模拟，我们建模了树枝状聚合物与核酸载体的相互作用。随后，我们采用传统二维细胞培养及近期建立的三维细胞培养来评估树枝状聚合物对NANPs摄取的影响。免疫激活通过多种工程化细胞系进行评估，这些细胞系携带由关键免疫信号通路驱动的报告基因。具体而言，使用HEK-lucia报告细胞评估RIG-I激活，而THP1-Dual细胞则为IRF和NF-κB转录因子活性提供定量读数。我们的研究结果表明，树枝状聚合物的代数和NANP组成均影响细胞摄取和免疫反应。本研究强调了制剂在塑造NANPs生物学特性中的重要性，并进一步增进了对其免疫学特性的理解，这对基于NANPs的佐剂开发至关重要。
